title: Breathing
style: cinematic horror film still, vast frozen northern lake under a pale winter sky, lonely ice fishing shacks, black open water, cold steel-blue and white tones with warm lantern amber, dramatic moody lighting, film grain, 35mm, highly detailed, subject clearly visible, no text, no watermark
caption:
Part 4. Wade hears it under the ice. It breathes when he breathes. 🌬️

Original fiction. Part 5 tomorrow night.

#scarystories #horrorstory #creepy #storytime #fyp

scenes.narration: Last time: Wade learned two divers went into the circle in 1974, only one came back, and wet footprints led from the lake to his door.
scenes.image: wet heavy boot prints on a snowy cabin porch at night, lantern light

scenes.narration: By morning the footprints are frozen solid. Wade doesn't follow them. He doesn't have to. He knows where they go.
scenes.image: trail of frozen boot prints leading away across a snowy shore onto the lake ice, grey morning

scenes.narration: He should leave. Instead, he sleeps in his shack, a hundred yards from the circle, with the lantern burning.
scenes.image: small fishing shack alone on a frozen lake at night, warm lantern glow through one window, stars above

scenes.narration: At two in the morning, the lantern flame leans. Toward the floor.
scenes.image: close-up of an old kerosene lantern flame bending sharply downward inside its glass, dark shack interior

scenes.narration: Then he hears it. A slow, deep inhale. Under the ice. Under him. So long it doesn't seem to end.
scenes.image: man lying awake in a sleeping bag on a shack floor, eyes wide, faint shape of something enormous beneath the ice below

scenes.narration: Then the exhale. The whole shack shivers. Frost cracks off the windows. The ice groans for a mile in every direction.
scenes.image: frozen lake at night with long cracks spreading across the ice in every direction from a small lit shack

scenes.narration: He presses his ear to the floor. It's breathing in rhythm. His rhythm. When he holds his breath, it holds its breath.
scenes.image: man pressing his ear against a frosted ice floor inside a shack, lantern light on his tense face

scenes.narration: Wade counts. Sixty seconds. Ninety. His lungs burn. Nothing that big should be able to wait that long.
scenes.image: close-up of a man's face red and straining as he holds his breath, frost on his eyebrows

scenes.narration: He gasps. And under the ice, at the same moment, something gasps with him.
scenes.image: dark underwater view of the underside of thick lake ice, a huge rush of silver bubbles rising against it

scenes.narration: Then a voice, muffled, a man's, right below the floor. Wade. It's warm down here. Come see.
scenes.image: the round fishing hole in a shack's ice floor glowing warm amber from below, lantern beside it, nobody visible
